necessary_original_statement_corrections.label: p1:arith:asymmetric
necessary_original_statement_corrections.title: An asymmetric pair profile
necessary_original_statement_corrections.finding: With the literal radius-one nonalignment predicate, T1.10 is false. For L=3k, X=2t, z=3t+3B and U_X=[X,X+3B], k matched coordinates above every H>=3 yield delta*>=k-1. All reduced slopes up to B^3 are excluded for t>5B^4, but the pairs are aligned at radius2. On m=2^(3k), N=6m, a dyadic family of m-B pairs gives a full profile at least m^(4/3)/8. This exceeds every constant multiple of N^(31/24+1/48), for every fixed positive integer cutoff multiple, on the critical band C=3.
necessary_original_statement_corrections.proposed_revision: Define asymmetric nonalignment with a radius depending explicitly on the old width D, for example max(1,D)*(r+s)*B. Reprove the31/24 profile for this enlarged exclusion and verify the enlarged aligned-sector estimates at each use. Radius2 is proved to exclude this witness family, but sufficiency of the revised lemma is not asserted.

necessary_original_statement_corrections.label: p13:short:quadratic
necessary_original_statement_corrections.title: A quadratic kernel with a prescribed divisor
necessary_original_statement_corrections.finding: For arbitrarily large N, actual admissible data h=e=1,n=N with squarefree N and N+1 give q=N(N+1)=N^beta(N), beta(N)>2 and delta=0. Then c2=beta(N)/2>1/2+beta(N)/4, while all asymptotic counting estimates remain valid.
necessary_original_statement_corrections.proposed_revision: Replace c2 by min(1,c2) in the exact displayed comparison; alternatively restrict beta-2delta<=2 or include the vanishing exponent margin. Retain the already proved uniform c2 and affine counting conclusions.
